Things to Do in Hauz Khas: Village, Lake & Market

Guide · 6 min read · 10 July 2026

Hauz Khas rewards a wander. In a single afternoon you can walk from a 14th-century reservoir and madrasa to a contemporary art gallery, a designer boutique and a rooftop dinner. Here's a route that ties it together.

Start at the lake and ruins

Enter the Hauz Khas Complex through Deer Park to reach the medieval tank, tombs and madrasa , the historic core that gives the neighbourhood its name and its best golden-hour views.

Browse art and boutiques

Weave through the Village lanes to galleries like Art Konsult and boutiques like OGAAN and Nappa Dori. This stretch is why Hauz Khas earned its 'ethnic chic' reputation.

End with food and a view

Close the loop with dinner at a rooftop like Mia Bella or drinks at Hauz Khas Social. Hungry now? Start with our guide to the best cafés and restaurants in Hauz Khas.
